# Official Uniswap artifacts

These untouched ABI/bytecode artifacts are extracted from the integrity-checked official npm releases named in manifest.json. No third-party installation scripts or legacy tools are executed. A test-only Solidity fixture contains the identical creation bytecode for an offline EVM rehearsal.

Uniswap V3 Core copyright 2021 Uniswap Labs. Original BUSL-1.1 terms are retained in V3-CORE-LICENSE. That notice specifies a change date no later than 2023-04-01 and GPL v2 or later as its change license.

SwapRouter02 and QuoterV2: GPL-2.0-or-later, original SWAP-ROUTER-LICENSE retained. Original sources and full corresponding source releases:

- https://github.com/Uniswap/v3-core/tree/ed88be38ab2032d82bf10ac6f8d03aa631889d48
- https://github.com/Uniswap/swap-router-contracts/tree/550c0f20373a487996fcc957075377b67af9df07

The user approved this exact artifact scope on 2026-10-01, review expires 2026-11-01. This is not a global GPL admission, an independent security approval, a permission to broadcast or a claim that these contracts are already deployed on Robinhood Chain Testnet. Preserve original notices with redistributions.
